title: Townsend Brown: worse than a thermonuclear bomb

tellings.quote: there's one line from a biography of Towns and Brown, you know, this Paul Schatzkin book, The Man Who Mastered Gravity, where it's you know, uh this will make a thermonuclear bomb look like a child's firecracker.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, quotes a line from The Man Who Mastered Gravity, a biography of an inventor named Townsend Brown written by Paul Schatzkin. According to Michels, the book says that something tied to Brown's work would make a thermonuclear bomb, the most powerful kind of nuclear weapon, look like a child's firecracker. He tells it to show how much power, if true, that work was thought to hold.
